## Maintainer ruling recorded — **A: declare `headerColor` as a closed enum**

Provenance: maintainer, 2026-08-26, live PM chat (decision-inbox batch 3, session `session_01JANH3y7qe3MD8aLaLXci8N`), verbatim: 「其他接受你的建议」 — accepting the presented recommendation A.

- `packages/spec` declares `headerColor` on the strict `record:details` section schema as **`z.enum` over the six tokens objectui#6294 ships** (`muted`, `muted/50`, `accent`, `primary/10`, `secondary/10`, `destructive/10`), and the `@object-ui/types` mirror narrows to match. Declared = enforced: `objectstack validate` rejects anything else at authoring time — an AI author writing `headerColor: 'blue-100'` is refused at compile time instead of shipping a header that silently does not paint.
- The implementing spec seat sanity-checks the six-token vocabulary once at dispatch (the tints-only reasoning: `CardHeader` sets no foreground, so solid backgrounds would need paired `text-*-foreground`) — a vocabulary adjustment within the enum shape needs no re-ruling; switching shapes (to B's open string) would.
- ⛔ B (open string — re-advertises the capability illusion), C (keep the refusal against a repaired renderer), D (retire — re-litigates objectui's settled Bug disposition) are not taken.
- The #11661 pin flips consciously, as its own comment anticipated. Precondition: verify objectui#6294 has MERGED (it was draft at filing); not merged ⇒ `pm:blocked` on it rather than dispatch.

State: `needs-user-decision` → **`pm:queue`** (`domain:spec` stands; Feature-class accept-set widening ⇒ clause-② discipline at that seat's dispatch).
